qolbundle.module.xray.name: X-ray (add-on)
qolbundle.module.xray.desc: Single-player / own server only; public servers ban for this. Outlines ores near you through walls.
When there are more, the nearest ones are shown.
qolbundle.module.xray.setting.extra_bloc: Block ids separated by commas, e.g. minecraft:spawner,minecraft:chest
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.qolbundle: Optional add-on for QoL Bundle: outlines nearby ores through walls. Off by default and meant for single-player and your own server only; many servers ban X-ray.
